experiments.experiment_title: Balancing Chemical Equations & Law of Conservation of Mass
experiments.learning_objective: To balance the number of atoms of reactants and products so that mass is conserved in a chemical equation.

experiments.experiment_title: Limiting Reactants and Formation of Products
experiments.learning_objective: To see how reactants combine in fixed ratios to form products and why some reactant is left over.

experiments.experiment_title: Reversible Reactions and Equilibrium
experiments.learning_objective: To understand how forward and reverse reactions occur and how the system reaches a balance of reactants and products.

experiments.experiment_title: Measuring the pH of Common Substances
experiments.learning_objective: To measure and compare the pH of everyday liquids and relate pH to H+ and OH- ion concentration.

experiments.experiment_title: Strong and Weak Acids and Bases
experiments.learning_objective: To compare the ionisation of strong and weak acids and bases in water and how it affects conductivity and pH.

experiments.experiment_title: Atomic Structure and Electron Configuration of Metals and Non-metals
experiments.learning_objective: To build atoms and ions and see how gaining or losing electrons leads to the formation of ionic compounds.

experiments.experiment_title: Ionic Compounds: Dissolving Salts
experiments.learning_objective: To observe how ionic compounds formed from metals and non-metals dissociate in water.

experiments.experiment_title: Building Covalent Molecules
experiments.learning_objective: To assemble molecules from atoms and understand covalent bonding and valency.

experiments.experiment_title: Shapes of Molecules and Bonding
experiments.learning_objective: To explore single, double and triple bonds and the 3D geometry of carbon-based molecules.

experiments.experiment_title: Polarity of Covalent Molecules
experiments.learning_objective: To relate electronegativity difference to bond polarity in covalent compounds.

experiments.experiment_title: Diffusion of Substances (Foundation for Transport and Exchange)
experiments.learning_objective: To observe how particles move from higher to lower concentration, the basis of gas exchange and transport in organisms.

experiments.experiment_title: Movement of Molecules Across Cell Membranes
experiments.learning_objective: To understand how substances cross a cell membrane through channels, relevant to absorption and excretion.

experiments.experiment_title: Nerve Impulse Transmission
experiments.learning_objective: To observe how a stimulus triggers an electrical impulse that travels along a neuron.

experiments.experiment_title: Inheritance of Traits and Variation in a Population
experiments.learning_objective: To see how dominant and recessive traits are inherited and how variation spreads through a population over generations.

experiments.experiment_title: From Genes to Proteins: Expression of Traits
experiments.learning_objective: To understand how genes are transcribed and translated into proteins that determine traits.

experiments.experiment_title: Image Formation by Mirrors and Lenses
experiments.learning_objective: To locate images formed by mirrors and lenses using object distance, focal length and ray diagrams.

experiments.experiment_title: Refraction of Light and Snell's Law
experiments.learning_objective: To investigate reflection and refraction at a boundary, the refractive index and total internal reflection.

subject_science.chapter_name: The Human Eye and the Colourful World

experiments.experiment_title: Eye as a Lens System: Accommodation and Defects of Vision
experiments.learning_objective: To model the eye lens, study focal length changes and see how converging and diverging lenses correct vision defects.

experiments.experiment_title: Dispersion of Light Through a Prism
experiments.learning_objective: To observe how different wavelengths bend by different amounts, explaining dispersion and the spectrum.

experiments.experiment_title: Colour Perception and Mixing of Light
experiments.learning_objective: To understand how mixing red, green and blue light produces different colours as perceived by the eye.

experiments.experiment_title: Building Series and Parallel Circuits
experiments.learning_objective: To build circuits and measure current and potential difference, and to compare resistors in series and in parallel.

experiments.experiment_title: Verifying Ohm's Law
experiments.learning_objective: To see how current varies with voltage and resistance according to V = IR.

experiments.experiment_title: Factors Affecting Resistance of a Conductor
experiments.learning_objective: To explore how resistance depends on resistivity, length and cross-sectional area.

experiments.experiment_title: Battery, Resistor and Heating Effect of Current
experiments.learning_objective: To visualise electron flow in a simple circuit and relate voltage, current and resistance.

experiments.experiment_title: Magnetic Field of a Bar Magnet
experiments.learning_objective: To map magnetic field lines and see how a compass aligns with the field of a magnet.

experiments.experiment_title: Magnetic Field Due to Current-Carrying Conductor and Electromagnets
experiments.learning_objective: To investigate how current, number of coil turns and battery polarity affect the strength and direction of an electromagnet.

experiments.experiment_title: Electromagnetic Induction
experiments.learning_objective: To observe induced current when a magnet moves relative to a coil.

experiments.experiment_title: Electric Generator Principle
experiments.learning_objective: To see how rotating a magnet near a coil produces current, the working principle of an AC generator.

experiments.experiment_title: Greenhouse Effect and Environmental Impact
experiments.learning_objective: To understand how greenhouse gases trap heat and affect Earth's temperature.

experiments.experiment_title: Energy Flow and Transformation (Foundation for Food Chains)
experiments.learning_objective: To track how energy is transferred and transformed, with losses as heat, as a foundation for energy flow between trophic levels.

experiments.experiment_title: Visualizing Zeroes and Parabolas of Quadratic Polynomials
experiments.learning_objective: To observe how changing the coefficients a, b, and c transforms the parabolic graph and shifts its x-intercepts (zeroes).

experiments.experiment_title: Graphs of Linear Polynomials and Their Zero
experiments.learning_objective: To see how a linear polynomial graph crosses the x-axis at its zero.

subject_mathematics.chapter_name: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables

experiments.experiment_title: Graphical Solution of Linear Equations
experiments.learning_objective: To graph linear equations and understand slope and intercepts, which determine whether two lines intersect, are parallel or coincide.

experiments.experiment_title: Balancing Equations by Elimination and Substitution Reasoning
experiments.learning_objective: To keep both sides of an equation balanced while performing operations, the idea behind elimination and substitution.

experiments.experiment_title: Roots of Quadratic Equations from Parabola Intercepts
experiments.learning_objective: To connect the roots of ax^2 + bx + c = 0 to x-intercepts and see how the discriminant relates to the number of real roots.

experiments.experiment_title: Factorisation and Completing the Square Using Area Models
experiments.learning_objective: To use area models to expand and factor algebraic expressions, supporting factorisation and completing the square.

experiments.experiment_title: AP as a Linear Function of n (Closest Conceptual Match)
experiments.learning_objective: To see that a constant common difference corresponds to a constant slope, so the nth term of an AP behaves as a linear function of n.

experiments.experiment_title: Similar Figures and Proportional Sides
experiments.learning_objective: To explore ratios and proportional scaling, the basis for similarity of triangles and the Basic Proportionality Theorem.

experiments.experiment_title: Right Triangles and the Pythagoras Theorem
experiments.learning_objective: To explore the relationship among the sides of a right triangle, including the Pythagorean relation, using a unit circle.

experiments.experiment_title: Plotting Points and Lines on the Cartesian Plane
experiments.learning_objective: To plot points and lines on the coordinate plane and relate coordinates to distance and slope.

experiments.experiment_title: Vectors and Coordinates on a Plane
experiments.learning_objective: To represent displacements using components on the x-y plane and understand distance between points.

experiments.experiment_title: Trigonometric Ratios and the Unit Circle
experiments.learning_objective: To see how sine, cosine and tangent change with angle and to verify basic identities such as sin^2 + cos^2 = 1.

experiments.experiment_title: Angles of Elevation/Depression and Heights via Trigonometric Ratios
experiments.learning_objective: To use trigonometric ratios of an angle to find unknown heights and distances in right triangles.

experiments.experiment_title: Resolving Quantities Into Components at an Angle
experiments.learning_objective: To apply sine and cosine to resolve a vector into horizontal and vertical components.

experiments.experiment_title: Understanding Area by Building Shapes (Closest Foundational Match)
experiments.learning_objective: To build shapes and compare area and perimeter, as a foundation for the area of sectors and segments.

experiments.experiment_title: Volume, Mass and Density of Solids
experiments.learning_objective: To relate the volume of objects to displaced liquid and to compare mass, volume and density of solids.

experiments.experiment_title: Area of Regions by Composition (Closest Foundational Match)
experiments.learning_objective: To compose complex regions from simpler ones and compute their area, as in combinations of solids.

experiments.experiment_title: Mean as a Balance Point and Sharing Equally
experiments.learning_objective: To understand the mean as the value obtained by leveling out or balancing a data set.

experiments.experiment_title: Median, Mode and Spread of Data
experiments.learning_objective: To explore measures of central tendency (mean, median, mode) and how data distribution affects them.

experiments.experiment_title: Experimental vs Theoretical Probability
experiments.learning_objective: To run many random trials and compare experimental frequencies with theoretical probabilities.
